title: DWG HATCH/MPOLYGON rational spline writer weight authority
scope: Define source-compatible authority between canonical spline weightlist and legacy control-point Z
Verify emitted DWG boundary weight bits independently of the library reader
Exercise generated AC1018 and AC1027 HATCH/MPOLYGON write/read plus HATCH DXF handoff without persistent fixtures

implementation.canonicalWeightList: A nonempty complete finite weightlist is authoritative and implies rational encoding, including all-unit and near-unit values.
implementation.legacyControlZ: When weightlist is empty and the rational flag is set, control-point Z remains the compatibility weight carrier.
implementation.unmarkedControlZ: When the list is empty and rational flag is clear, control-point Z does not infer rationality and is not emitted as a weight.
implementation.conflictingMirrors: Canonical weights win; source spline weightlist and control-point coordinates are unchanged by encoding.
implementation.invalidInput: Partial canonical arrays and non-finite effective weights are rejected before output buffer mutation.
